# ghost/kotlin-quiz

Kotlin Quiz (F-Droid): a 10 question multiple choice quiz about the Kotlin language with a final score. Offline, only a display name, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/kotlin-quiz
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/kotlin-quiz start_quiz --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/kotlin-quiz get_question --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/kotlin-quiz answer --device <serial> --param option=<option>
ghost skill run ghost/kotlin-quiz answer_many --device <serial> --param options=<options>
ghost skill run ghost/kotlin-quiz get_result --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/kotlin-quiz finish_quiz --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `start_quiz`: Start the Kotlin quiz
- `get_question`: What is the Kotlin quiz question now?
- `answer`: Answer the Kotlin quiz question with option 2
- `answer_many`: Answer the next three Kotlin quiz questions with 3, 1 and 2
- `get_result`: What is my Kotlin quiz score?
- `finish_quiz`: Finish the Kotlin quiz
